u0: No duty is currently pending: the siren is not awaiting a switch-off, no client's order is waiting to be taken or completed, and no fallen food needs recovery. The agent should stay ready for the next event, then silence a new siren, handle any arriving client through ordering, preparation, and service, and recover food at once if it slips. Several such duties may arise together.
u1: The siren is ringing and has not yet been switched off. The agent needs to reach the siren switch and toggle it; once silenced, that duty is cleared. A client arrival or a food slip during this time would add a separate task.
u10: Prepared food has just slipped from the agent's hands, and the waiting client has not yet been served. The food must be picked up on the very next step or the task fails; after recovery, it still needs to be delivered to the client. Preparation is already complete, so only recovery and service remain.
u11: The siren is ringing, prepared food has slipped, and the client is still waiting to be served. The agent must recover food on the immediate next step, then silence the siren and serve the prepared food. The order remains incomplete until that service happens.
u12: A client has arrived and its order has not yet been taken. The agent needs to face the client and take the order; after that, obtaining and preparing food and then serving it will remain. The client keeps waiting, so this duty stays until the order is taken.
u13: A client is waiting with its order untaken, and the siren is ringing. The agent owes both an order-taking visit to the client and a switch-off at the siren panel; completing either one leaves the other undone. Once the order is taken, preparing and serving the food will still be required.
u14: A client's order still needs to be taken, and prepared food also remains to be served. The agent must complete both duties; taking the order does not by itself deliver the prepared food, and serving food does not by itself take a new order. Either a new siren ring or a slip would add another obligation.
u15: The siren is ringing, a client's order has not yet been taken, and prepared food remains unserved. All three duties are outstanding: silence the alarm, take the order, and deliver the prepared food. Completing one leaves the others still required.
u16: A client has arrived with its order still untaken, and food has just slipped from the agent's hands. The agent must recover food on the very next step to avoid failure; the order can be taken after the food is secured. Preparation and service for that order will then still remain.
u17: The siren is ringing, a client is waiting with its order untaken, and food has just slipped. Recovery on the next step is mandatory to avoid failure; afterward the agent can silence the siren and take the order. The order will still require preparation and service.
u18: A client's order is still untaken, prepared food is waiting to be served, and food has just slipped. Recovering food on the immediate next step is mandatory; after that, the agent must both take the order and serve the prepared food. Neither duty clears the other.
u19: The siren is ringing, a client's order remains untaken, prepared food remains to be served, and food has just slipped. The immediate next step must restore food to the agent's hands or the task fails; afterward, silencing the siren, taking the order, and serving the prepared food all remain. Each duty is cleared only by its own completion.
u2: A client's order has been taken, but the food for it has not yet been prepared. The agent still needs to fetch food if necessary, prepare it at the stove, and serve it to the waiting client. A new siren or a slip of the carried food can add another duty before this sequence is finished.
u20: A client is waiting to have their order taken, and an order taken earlier is still waiting for its food to be prepared. No siren alarm or immediate fallen-food recovery is pending. You need to take the waiting client's order and prepare food for the earlier order, then serve the prepared food when it is ready.
u21: The siren is ringing and must be switched off. A client is waiting to have their order taken, and an order taken earlier still needs food prepared. After preparation, that food must eventually be served.
u22: Food has just slipped and must be picked up on the very next step, or the task will fail. A client is waiting to have their order taken, and an order taken earlier still needs food prepared. Once prepared, the food must eventually be served.
u23: Food has just slipped and must be picked up on the very next step, or the task will fail; the ringing siren must be switched off as well. A client is waiting to have their order taken, and an order taken earlier still needs food prepared. The prepared food must eventually be served.
u24: Food has been prepared and still needs to be served, and a taken order still needs food prepared. No siren alarm or immediate fallen-food recovery is pending. You must prepare food for the outstanding order and serve the already-prepared food.
u25: The siren is ringing and must be switched off. Food has been prepared and still needs to be served, and a taken order still needs food prepared. You must handle the siren, prepare food for the outstanding order, and eventually serve the prepared food.
u26: Food has just slipped and must be picked up on the very next step, or the task will fail. Food has already been prepared and still needs to be served, and a taken order still needs food prepared. These obligations remain after the immediate pickup.
u27: Food has just slipped and must be picked up on the very next step, or the task will fail; the ringing siren must also be switched off. Food has already been prepared and still needs to be served, and a taken order still needs food prepared. All of these obligations must be handled.
u28: Food slipped and was not recovered on the very next step, so a mandatory requirement has been broken for good. The task can no longer succeed, and no further action can repair the failure.
u29: Food has already been prepared and still needs to be served, a taken order still needs food prepared, and a client is waiting to have their order taken. No siren alarm or immediate fallen-food recovery is pending. You must take the waiting client's order, prepare food for the outstanding order, and serve the prepared food.
u3: An order has been taken and still needs its food prepared and served, while the siren is ringing. The agent has both jobs outstanding: go through preparation and delivery for the waiting client, and silence the siren at its switch. There is no immediate deadline on either, but both must eventually be completed.
u30: The siren is ringing and must be switched off. Food has already been prepared and still needs to be served, a taken order still needs food prepared, and a client is waiting to have their order taken. All of these obligations remain.
u31: Food has just slipped and must be picked up on the very next step, or the task will fail. Food has already been prepared and still needs to be served, a taken order still needs food prepared, and a client is waiting to have their order taken. These other obligations remain after the immediate pickup.
u32: Food has just slipped and must be picked up on the very next step, or the task will fail; the ringing siren must also be switched off. Food has already been prepared and still needs to be served, a taken order still needs food prepared, and a client is waiting to have their order taken. All of these obligations must be handled.
u4: Prepared food is ready for the waiting client but has not yet been handed over. The remaining objective is to carry it to the client and serve it; once served, this duty is finished. A new siren ring or a slip would add a separate obligation.
u5: Prepared food is waiting to be served, and the siren is ringing. The agent must both deliver the prepared order and turn the siren off; these can be done in either order, but neither disappears until completed. A slip while carrying the prepared food would add an urgent recovery.
u6: Food has just slipped from the agent's hands, leaving the agent empty-handed. Food must be held again on the very next step, or the task fails irreversibly. After that immediate pickup, no other duty is pending in this state.
u7: The siren is ringing and food has just slipped, so the agent is empty-handed. The slip must be recovered on the very next step to avoid failure; silencing the siren can wait until after that, but remains required. Once both are dealt with, no other duty is pending.
u8: An order has been taken and still needs its food prepared, while the food being handled has just slipped away. Recovering food on the very next step is mandatory to avoid failure, after which the agent can prepare the ordered food and serve it. Both preparation and service remain outstanding.
u9: The siren is ringing, a taken order still needs food prepared and served, and food has just slipped. Recovery on the immediately following step is mandatory; only afterward can the agent silence the siren and continue preparing the order. The client's order is not finished until the prepared food is served.
